chapters.title: Total product and division

frames.caption: Total product and division — O(n) time, O(1) extra space. Input: product_except_self(nums=[-1, 1, 0, -3, 3]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
return [total if x == 0 else 0 for x in nums] — x = -1
return [total if x == 0 else 0 for x in nums] — x = 1
return [total if x == 0 else 0 for x in nums] — x = 0
return [total if x == 0 else 0 for x in nums] — x = -3
return [total if x == 0 else 0 for x in nums] — x = 3
return [total if x == 0 else 0 for x in nums] — returns [0, 0, 9, 0, 0]. Result: [0, 0, 9, 0, 0]

chapters.title: Prefix and suffix product arrays

frames.caption: Prefix and suffix product arrays — O(n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: product_except_self(nums=[-1, 1, 0, -3, 3]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
return [a * b for a, b in zip(left, right)] — a = 1; b = 0
return [a * b for a, b in zip(left, right)] — a = -1
return [a * b for a, b in zip(left, right)] — b = -9
return [a * b for a, b in zip(left, right)] — a = 0; b = 3
return [a * b for a, b in zip(left, right)] — b = 1
return [a * b for a, b in zip(left, right)] — returns [0, 0, 9, 0, 0]. Result: [0, 0, 9, 0, 0]
